 Thursday, October 29, 2026 Training available for nonpartisan Election Day volunteers
 October 29, 2026 
 < 1 min. read
 The Office of University Relations is hosting a nonpartisan Election Day volunteer training.
 All students, faculty and staff interested in serving as nonpartisan Election Day volunteers on Nov. 3 for the midterm election must participate in one of the upcoming trainings. Trainings will be held on Friday, Oct. 30, and Monday, Nov. 2.
 The Office of University Relations is seeking Marquette students, faculty and staff to volunteer for a minimum of two hours. Volunteers will provide support at the AMU polling site, as well as several off-campus polling site locations that serve the Marquette community. The sign-up for volunteer roles will be available at each of the trainings.
 Fill out this form to register. 
 If you are interested in nonpartisan Election Day volunteer training but are unable to make the trainings, reach out to Kelsey Otero at Kelsey.otero@marquette.edu .
